- heading "AI Quality Automation Engineer" [level=2]
- heading "MED-EL" [level=2]
- heading "Innsbruck, Austria" [level=2]
- heading "Your Tasks" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Design and build AI-powered automation for software quality assurance, reducing manual testing effort over time;
  - listitem: Develop test and evaluation infrastructure for workflow, end-to-end, REST/gRPC API and contract testing, with CI/CD integration;
  - listitem: Build tools and agents that generate and execute tests, inspect behavior, analyze failures and highlight release risks;
  - listitem: Collaborate with software engineers across Dart/Flutter apps, C#/.NET services, APIs and cloud infrastructure throughout development;
  - listitem: Perform exploratory, integration and release testing where needed, and turn proven manual checks into scalable automation.
- heading "Your Profile" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: "Bachelor`s degree or higher (University, FH) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI or a related field, or equivalent practical experience;"
  - listitem: Programming skills for building engineering tools and automation; experience with C#/.NET, Python or Dart/Flutter is valuable;
  - listitem: Experience with automated testing for REST/gRPC APIs, mobile apps, backend systems and/or end-to-end workflows;
  - listitem: Understanding of CI/CD, API contracts, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure and modern software delivery practices;
  - listitem: Interest or experience with LLMs, AI agents, tool use and agentic workflows, turning prototypes into reliable solutions.
